proposed_record.positioning: Google DeepMind open-weight Gemma 4 instruction model for reasoning, coding, agentic workflows and multimodal understanding.

proposed_record.positioning: Z.ai open-weight flagship model for complex coding, long-horizon agentic tasks and cybersecurity reasoning.

proposed_record.positioning: Qwen code-generation model optimized for repository-level understanding, multi-turn tool interactions and agentic coding compatibility.
notes: Alibaba Cloud publishes three input-length pricing bands for EU and international endpoints.

proposed_record.positioning: Gemini 3.8 Flash post-training variant for approved cybersecurity use cases with multimodal input and long context.
notes: Generally available behind an allowlist; access requires Google team or Fairwind approval.
Global Standard token pricing is represented; non-global and Flex/Batch rates remain separate service tiers.

proposed_record.positioning: OpenAI specialized reasoning model for approved life-sciences research workflows and scientific tool use.
notes: API access is limited to eligible organizations and approved internal research through OpenAI's trusted-access program.
Published API billing begins October 5, 2026.

proposed_record.positioning: xAI speech-to-speech voice model with integrated reasoning and tool-use support for realtime conversational agents.
notes: The versioned model is billed at $0.08 per minute of audio and is excluded from the token calculator.
grok-voice-latest currently points to this version, while the pinned ID is used canonically for stability.
